issuer: Connecticut State Board of Labor Relations (SBLR)
title: Connecticut SBLR — Decision No. 5342 — NEWTOWN BOARD OF EDUCATION
text:
STATE OF CONNECTICUT
LABOR DEPARTMENT
CONNECTICUT STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS
_________________________________________
In the matter of
NEWTOWN BOARD OF EDUCATION
-and- DECISION NO. 5342
IFPTE, LOCAL 136-13, NEWTOWN PARAEDUCATORS
DECEMBER 24, 2024
CASE NO. ME-35,482_______________________
DECISION AND EXPANSION OF UNIT
Pursuant to the Confirmation of Agreement for Consent Election, dated December 2
2024, an election by secret ballot was conducted on December 17, 2024, at Newtown,
Connecticut under the supervision of the Connecticut State Board of Labor Relations. The tally
of ballots was as follows:
Number of Ballots Cast . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 5
Number of Ballots Counted . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 5
Number of Votes IN FAVOR of representation. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 4
Number of Votes NOT IN FAVOR of representation. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 1
Number of Blank Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 0
Number of Void Ballots. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 0
Number of Challenged Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 0
Copies of the Report Upon Secret Ballot were duly served upon all parties. No
exceptions to the report or objections to the election were filed with the Board.
Since the parties have agreed that the unit is appropriate, the Board’s approval of the
action herein is not to be taken as a precedent as to what unit it would find appropriate in the
absence of such an agreement.
Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the power vested in the Connecticut State Board
of Labor Relations by the Municipal Employee Relations Act, it is hereby,
DETERMINED that the existing unit of employees, represented for the purposes of
collective bargaining by IFPTE, Local 136-13, Newtown Paraeducators, is expanded to include
all Job Coaches employed by the Newtown Board of Education and that said IFPTE, Local 136-
13, Newtown Paraeducators is the exclusive representative of all said employees for the
purpose of collective bargaining with respect to wages, hours and other conditions of
employment.

CONNECTICUT STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS
